pass_meaning: Actual v0 supervision semantics fixed and understood; robot occlusion is NOT solved. Static source audit, not a packaged-scene or training test.

input_semantics.RGB: T14 full-frame RGB PNG, not pre-masked
input_semantics.object_mask: T15 single-channel uint8 0/255, loaded as M=mask/255; exactly one object label, never classified as obstacle/robot
input_semantics.reader_output_mask_object: Despite name, RGB image I*M (black background), not a binary loss-weight array
input_semantics.gt_label: Dataset converts masked RGB to CHW float /255, returns as gt_label; unmasked RGB retained separately in full_gt_label

v0_supervision_convention.object_mask_role: Modify GT appearance, not foreground-only loss weighting
v0_supervision_convention.packaging_requirement: Future scene metadata must classify the sole object-mask ID in prompt_dict.object; no fake obstacle class/files and no object class in obstacle list. Only object ID directory is needed. This contract does not package a scene or alter configs.
v0_supervision_convention.empty_obstacle_fallback: Existing dataset creates zeros [T,1,H,W] for controller_img_mask_list and pure_robot_img_mask_list. Zeros mean no exclusion information, NOT a measured robot mask.
v0_supervision_convention.render_GT: G=I*M/255 for uint8 I; all non-object pixels become black
v0_supervision_convention.L2_weight: W=1-controller_img_mask=1 everywhere in effective full-frame bbox
v0_supervision_convention.SSIM_domain: Full effective image including black background and boundaries; local-window statistics
v0_supervision_convention.variant_consistency: Keep these conventions identical for no-tactile baseline and tactile comparison unless separately authorized as an ablation.

loss_paths.Stage1: dataset gt_label/controller_img_mask_list -> gs_simulator_embodied.forward_train frame_idx+1 -> _encode_decode_train -> AccDecoder.forward_train -> SimHead.loss(term_filter=[render]) -> L2Loss/SSIMLoss
loss_paths.Stage2: gs_simulator_embodied_stage2 follows same mask/decode-head render loss path
loss_paths.crop: AccDecoder crops prediction, GT and complement-mask weights to supplied bbox. bbox_reader with bounding_box=None supplies entire image; no implicit foreground crop.

L2_semantics.implementation: l2_error: elementwise squared error times mask_weights, then sum RGB channels and configured reduction; L2Loss averages camera results and applies loss_weight
L2_semantics.robot_region_when_object_mask_zero: GT zero and L2 weight one; rendered object at occluded pixels can be penalized rather than ignored

SSIM_semantics.reason: SSIMLoss.forward accepts it in **kwargs but does not forward kwargs/mask_weights to ssim_error; ssim_error calls Kornia ssim_loss without masking
SSIM_semantics.cloth_lift_configuration: kernel_size=5, max_val=1, reduction=sum, loss_weight=0.1*render_loss_weight; averaged across cameras
SSIM_semantics.note: Even with future real robot mask, current L2 and SSIM exclusion semantics differ; SSIM window effects can cross object/occlusion boundaries.

controller_robot_mask_semantics.controller_img_mask_list: Union of all obstacle masks, clipped [0,1], including robot subset; name does not mean projected controller anchors
controller_robot_mask_semantics.pure_robot_img_mask_list: Subset of obstacles whose label contains robot; separately unioned and clipped. Current Stage1/2 training does not consume this field for render loss. Only an inactive commented test reference found elsewhere.
controller_robot_mask_semantics.occlusion_role: Only complement of controller_img_mask_list weights current L2; does not mask GT via this path, and not used by SSIM.

limitations: No independent robot obstacle mask. Occluded cloth pixels outside object segmentation are black target, not ignore regions.
Loss on black background imposes silhouette/background constraints; not foreground-only photometric supervision.
Object segmentation errors remain in target.
SSIM ignores mask_weights even if nonzero robot obstacles are later provided.
Current canonical RGB/mask assets alone are not a complete SoMA scene; label metadata/paths must be wired consistently in later packaging.

separate_tasks: Obtain/validate independent robot obstacle masks and wire them through existing obstacle path; do not derive them by relabeling object mask.
Independently design and validate SSIM masking including window-boundary and normalization semantics; not solved simply by passing mask_weights.

source_evidence.finding: label roles, mask/255, GT masking, optional white background
full bbox default; masked GT; empty obstacle/robot zeros; return names
render filter and shared mask_weights dispatch
weights applied elementwise then channel sum and reduction
same target-frame GT and obstacle masks

provenance.audit_method: Read-only source tracing and repository-wide pure_robot_img_mask search; no runtime training/model test.
